title: An explicit separation ratio has an exponential floor
source_anchor: Proposition B.7 Eq19 second inequality and Appendix B.2.2 final proof paragraph A2.SS2.SSS2.p6
target_statement: For every natural dimension \(n\ge3\) and real \(\kappa\ge4\), set \(\rho_\kappa=(\sqrt{\kappa}-1)/(\sqrt{\kappa}+1)\). Then \(\frac12e^{-5n/\sqrt{\kappa}}\le\rho_\kappa^n/(2+4n\sqrt{\kappa}/(\sqrt{\kappa}+1)^2)\). This is the second scalar inequality of (19); the first inequality from actual TV to the ratio is separate.
